description: This file defines a ConversationalAgent class implementing an INode interface, which manages a conversational agent for chat models. It includes methods for initialization and running the agent, handling prompts, tools, memory, and vision support, and constructs agent sequences with various configurations.

classes.name: ConversationalAgent_Agents
classes.description: Implements a conversational agent node for chat models, supporting prompts, tools, memory, vision, and streaming responses.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the agent node with default parameters and configuration options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Prepares the agent with node data, input, and options, returning an initialized agent instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the agent with given node data, input, and options, handling moderation, streaming, and response formatting.
